title: "North Carolina Senate History: Female vs. Male Matchups"
author: "Trinity Harden"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

::: {.lead}
Exploring electoral patterns in North Carolina statewide races featuring a female candidate running against a male candidate.
:::

In North Carolina electoral history, several high-profile U.S. Senate races have featured a female candidate facing a male opponent. Most recently in **2022**, former North Carolina Supreme Court Chief Justice **Cheri Beasley** (Democrat) became the first Black woman nominated for U.S. Senate in the state, running against **Ted Budd** (Republican).

The interactive map below allows you to compare county-level outcomes in the **2022 woman-vs-man contest** against the **2026 contest**. Use the layer selector in the top-right corner to toggle between elections, and hover over any county to inspect candidate vote shares and victory margins.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tigris)
library(leaflet)
library(htmltools)

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

# 1. Download and process 2022 U.S. Senate results (Cheri Beasley vs Ted Budd)
url_2022 <- "https://s3.amazonaws.com/dl.ncsbe.gov/ENRS/2022_11_08/results_pct_20221108.zip"
temp22 <- tempfile(fileext = ".zip")
download.file(url_2022, temp22, quiet = TRUE)
raw22 <- read_tsv(unz(temp22, "results_pct_20221108.txt"), show_col_types = FALSE)

margin_2022 <- raw22 |>
  filter(`Contest Name` == "US SENATE") |>
  group_by(County, Choice) |>
  summarize(votes = sum(`Total Votes`), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(Choice %in% c("Cheri Beasley", "Ted Budd")) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Choice, values_from = votes, values_fill = 0) |>
  mutate(
    total_22 = `Cheri Beasley` + `Ted Budd`,
    beasley_pct = round(`Cheri Beasley` / total_22 * 100, 1),
    budd_pct = round(`Ted Budd` / total_22 * 100, 1),
    margin_2022 = round(beasley_pct - budd_pct, 1),
    county_upper = toupper(County)
  )

# 2. Download and process 2026 U.S. Senate results (Roy Cooper vs Michael Whatley)
url_2026 <- "https://s3.amazonaws.com/dl.ncsbe.gov/ENRS/2026_11_03/results_pct_20261103.zip"
temp26 <- tempfile(fileext = ".zip")
download.file(url_2026, temp26, quiet = TRUE)
raw26 <- read_tsv(unz(temp26, "results_pct_20261103.txt"), show_col_types = FALSE)

margin_2026 <- raw26 |>
  filter(`Contest Name` == "US SENATE") |>
  group_by(County, Choice) |>
  summarize(votes = sum(`Total Votes`), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(Choice %in% c("Roy Cooper", "Michael Whatley")) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Choice, values_from = votes, values_fill = 0) |>
  mutate(
    total_26 = `Roy Cooper` + `Michael Whatley`,
    cooper_pct = round(`Roy Cooper` / total_26 * 100, 1),
    whatley_pct = round(`Michael Whatley` / total_26 * 100, 1),
    margin_2026 = round(cooper_pct - whatley_pct, 1),
    county_upper = toupper(County)
  )

# 3. Download county boundaries and join election datasets
nc_counties <- counties(state = "NC", cb = TRUE, progress_bar = FALSE) |>
  st_transform(crs = 4326) |>
  mutate(county_upper = toupper(NAME)) |>
  left_join(margin_2022, by = "county_upper") |>
  left_join(margin_2026, by = "county_upper")

# Color palette for Democratic vs Republican margin
bins <- c(-80, -40, -20, -5, 5, 20, 40, 80)
pal <- colorBin(
  palette = c("#ca0020", "#f4a582", "#fddbc7", "#d1e5f0", "#92c5de", "#4393c3", "#2166ac"),
  domain = c(-80, 80),
  bins = bins
)

# Interactive hover labels for both years
labels_2022 <- sprintf(
  "<strong>%s County (2022)</strong><br/>
   Cheri Beasley (Woman / Dem): %s%% (%s votes)<br/>
   Ted Budd (Man / Rep): %s%% (%s votes)<br/>
   <strong>Margin:</strong> %s%%",
  nc_counties$NAME,
  nc_counties$beasley_pct, scales::comma(nc_counties$`Cheri Beasley`),
  nc_counties$budd_pct, scales::comma(nc_counties$`Ted Budd`),
  ifelse(nc_counties$margin_2022 > 0, paste0("+", nc_counties$margin_2022), nc_counties$margin_2022)
) |> lapply(HTML)

labels_2026 <- sprintf(
  "<strong>%s County (2026)</strong><br/>
   Roy Cooper (Man / Dem): %s%% (%s votes)<br/>
   Michael Whatley (Man / Rep): %s%% (%s votes)<br/>
   <strong>Margin:</strong> %s%%",
  nc_counties$NAME,
  nc_counties$cooper_pct, scales::comma(nc_counties$`Roy Cooper`),
  nc_counties$whatley_pct, scales::comma(nc_counties$`Michael Whatley`),
  ifelse(nc_counties$margin_2026 > 0, paste0("+", nc_counties$margin_2026), nc_counties$margin_2026)
) |> lapply(HTML)

# 4. Interactive comparative Leaflet map
leaflet(nc_counties, height = 550) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  addPolygons(
    group = "2022: Woman vs Man (Beasley vs Budd)",
    fillColor = ~pal(margin_2022),
    weight = 1,
    opacity = 1,
    color = "white",
    fillOpacity = 0.75,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 2, color = "#333", fillOpacity = 0.95, bringToFront = TRUE),
    label = labels_2022
  ) |>
  addPolygons(
    group = "2026: Man vs Man (Cooper vs Whatley)",
    fillColor = ~pal(margin_2026),
    weight = 1,
    opacity = 1,
    color = "white",
    fillOpacity = 0.75,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 2, color = "#333", fillOpacity = 0.95, bringToFront = TRUE),
    label = labels_2026
  ) |>
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c(
      "2022: Woman vs Man (Beasley vs Budd)",
      "2026: Man vs Man (Cooper vs Whatley)"
    ),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    pal = pal,
    values = c(-80, 80),
    title = "Democratic Margin (%)",
    position = "bottomright"
  )
```
